Cumberland Infant School & Little Cumberland Pre-School
IMPORTANT INFORMATION LETTER - PLEASE READ - Please click to see letter.
Breakfast & After School Club
Contact Club Mobile during Club hours 07526 262333
The school has its own Breakfast and After School Club, which can take up to
30 children for Breakfast Club and up to 45 children for After School Club.
Whilst in The Stem Hub, children can choose from a range of STEM activities including Lego, games and puzzles.
If a child is going to be attending the club on a regular basis
we advise that parents ensure their ScoPay account is in credit and book their places well in advance.
After School Club is very popular and we cannot guarantee that there will always be spaces available,
but parents are able to check the availability daily and book on the day if they wish.
Please speak to the School Office Team or the Club Leader if you are paying using Childcare Vouchers.
During the sessions the children have time in the playground and in the Club room
where they can choose from a range of activities for example,
creative crafts, board games, role play and construction equipment (Lego etc)

pageCache.pageTitle: Sporting Events | Cumberland Infant School & Little Cumberland Pre-School
pageCache.text:
Cumberland Infant School & Little Cumberland Pre-School
Sporting Events
Sports Week
Sports week is an annual event that happens at Cumberland near the end of the Academic year. Children attend school in their P.E kit (red top, black shorts with plimsoles or trainers) for the whole week! All children will take part in a range of sports ranging from tennis, cricket, tri golf, basketball, netball, rugby , dance and roundnet/flickball.
Sports Week Photos!
Alternative Sports Event!
Some of our Year 1s and Year 2s got the opportunity to try out some different sports they haven't tried before! They enjoyed sports such as; curling, archery, sit down volleyball plus a few more. Lots of fun was had!
Gymnastics and Trampolining!
Some of our Year 2 children got the opportunity to try out and learn some gymnastic and trampolining skills! They got to visit the new Portsmouth University Ravelin Centre.
BMX Champions Visit Cumberland!
Cumberland Infant School & Little Cumberland Pre-School

pageCache.pageTitle: International Dance Day! | Cumberland Infant School & Little Cumberland Pre-School
pageCache.text:
Cumberland Infant School & Little Cumberland Pre-School
International Dance Day!
We were extremely lucky to celebrate International Dance Day with visitors teaching the children, and us, a range of different dances from around the world. We had workshops from 2 parents, and some of the activities included African, India and Street dance. We had a wonderful day!
Cumberland Infant School & Little Cumberland Pre-School
